pieces.description: A young girl with curly blue-streaked hair looks up through sun-dappled water, ribbons and beads in her hair.

pieces.title: Inside the Emerald Barrel
pieces.description: A dreadlocked surfer rides deep inside a glowing emerald barrel wave.

pieces.title: The Barrel's Eye
pieces.description: A surfer crouches inside the curling eye of a turquoise wave as sunlight pours through the barrel.

pieces.title: The Leopard Strongman
pieces.description: A mustached vintage strongman in a leopard singlet poses with heavy dumbbells before a circus banner in sepia tones.

pieces.title: The Contortionist
pieces.description: A vintage circus contortionist bends into an impossible arc on a draped stage in sepia tones.

pieces.title: Floral Dress in Dappled Light
pieces.description: A curly-haired girl with blue streaks and flowers in her hair gazes upward through dappled light in an embroidered floral dress with lace.

pieces.title: Riding the Turquoise Wave
pieces.description: A dreadlocked surfer carves across a towering turquoise wave as the sun sets over the sea.

pieces.title: Blue Streaks and Blossoms
pieces.description: A close portrait of a curly-haired girl with blue streaks, blossoms in her hair and sunlight dappling her embroidered floral dress.

pieces.title: Through the Toxic Mist
pieces.description: Four masked young travellers push through green toxic mist in a sunlit forest.

pieces.title: The Victor's Silence
pieces.description: A bruised young victor stands silent on an arena stage as confetti falls over the cheering crowd.

pieces.title: The Cracked Screen
pieces.description: A mining-town crowd gathers at dusk beneath a giant cracked screen.

pieces.title: The Prep Room
pieces.description: A grim-faced young tribute sits at a makeup table while his flamboyant stylists prepare him in a bright dressing room.

pieces.title: Touching the Barrier
pieces.description: A startled boy reaches out to touch a rippling invisible barrier in the forest at sunset.

pieces.title: The Workshop Lesson
pieces.description: An older craftsman teaches a young man to solder circuit boards in a dim, cluttered workshop.

pieces.title: Morning in Pencil
pieces.description: A blonde woman in a white shirt smiles over the back of a chair in a pencil-style bedroom portrait.

pieces.title: The Sketch at the Marble Table
pieces.description: A blonde woman leans over a marble table beside a glass of whiskey and a sheet of Papa Shmu sketches.

pieces.title: Latte and Sketches
pieces.description: A blonde woman sits at a cafe table with a latte, figure sketches spread out before her.

pieces.title: Paris Balcony, Side View
pieces.description: A red-haired woman in a green sweater dress looks back from a Paris balcony, with Le Figaro and coffee on the table beside her.

pieces.title: Coffee Over Paris
pieces.description: A red-haired woman holds a coffee cup on a Paris balcony above the rooftops, Le Figaro open on the marble table.

pieces.title: Red Hair Over the Rooftops
pieces.description: A red-haired woman sips coffee on a Paris balcony, the city's rooftops sketched in grey behind her.

pieces.title: Neon Sunset Curls
pieces.description: A curly-haired girl with blue streaks looks up against a vaporwave neon sunset, dappled light across her face.

pieces.title: White Tank in Dappled Light
pieces.description: A blonde curly-haired girl with blue streaks sits in dappled sunlight wearing a white tank top.

pieces.title: Beaded Curls and Blossoms
pieces.description: A young girl with blue-streaked curls and beaded floral hair ornaments gazes upward in dappled light, wearing an embroidered floral dress.

pieces.title: Black Tank and a White Bow
pieces.description: A blonde curly-haired girl with blue streaks and a white bow looks up through dappled light in a black tank top.

pieces.title: The Bearded Lady

pieces.title: Moon Over the Dark Alley
pieces.description: A montage of moonlit gothic alleys, fog rolling over wet cobblestones beneath a full moon, closing with the Papa Shmu outro.

pieces.title: The Dog-Faced Boy
pieces.description: A sepia sideshow portrait of the dog-faced boy standing before painted portraits of the act's elders.

pieces.title: The Giant and the Little Man
pieces.description: A towering giant and a tiny suited showman stand side by side on a sepia circus stage.

pieces.title: The Fire Breather

pieces.title: The Electric Lady
pieces.description: A sequined performer holds crackling electric sparks in both hands against a draped stage backdrop.

pieces.title: The Conjoined Sisters
pieces.description: Conjoined twin sisters in matching Victorian lace dresses pose together in a sepia sideshow portrait.

pieces.title: Fog Over the Cobbles
pieces.description: Gas lamps glow through thick fog on a moonlit Victorian cobblestone street.

pieces.title: The Lone Figure in the Fog
pieces.description: A lone figure walks a fog-drowned cobblestone street beneath lamplit Victorian facades.

pieces.title: Rain on the Old Street
pieces.description: Rain-slick cobbles mirror the lamps of a narrow old street under a moonlit storm sky.

pieces.title: The Twisted Hollow
pieces.description: Twisted bare branches arch into a tunnel over a fog-choked forest path.

pieces.title: The House the Fog Kept
pieces.description: A derelict house sags in ground fog beneath a bruised dusk sky.

pieces.title: Laundry Over the Dark Alley
pieces.description: Laundry hangs over a narrow, lamp-lit alley where wet cobbles vanish into the dark.

pieces.title: The Ghost on the Stairs
pieces.description: A shrouded ghost drifts on the ruined staircase of a decaying mansion as a shaft of light breaks through the gloom.

pieces.title: The Archway Watch
pieces.description: Torchlight and fog fill a vaulted stone archway where a lone figure waits at the far end.

pieces.title: Moon Over the Old Graveyard
pieces.description: Tilted tombstones lean through ground fog beneath a cloud-torn full moon and bare twisted trees.

pieces.title: Fog on the Lamplit Street
pieces.description: Gas lamps glow through rolling fog on a wet Victorian street as a lone figure walks away into the night.

pieces.title: The Green Mist Alley
pieces.description: A lone figure stands in a mist-choked alley between weathered tenements under a sickly green-grey light.

pieces.title: Wind at the Boardwalk
pieces.description: A smiling woman in a white sundress leans on a boardwalk rail as sea wind and gulls sweep the shore behind her.

pieces.title: Girl in the Golden Wheat

pieces.title: Morning at the Rainy Window
pieces.description: A young woman in a white lace dress curls up on a rainy window seat with a steaming mug, lost in the grey morning light.

pieces.title: The Girl at the Stable Door
pieces.description: A smiling woman in a white sundress leans on a weathered barn stall while her horse watches from the golden light behind her.

pieces.title: Lantern Light on the Porch
pieces.description: A brunette in a white dress leans against a saloon porch post at dusk, lanterns glowing warm against the blue night.

pieces.title: Coffee in the Garden Light
pieces.description: A dark-haired woman in a white lace dress sits at a garden café table with coffee and a croissant, daydreaming in the morning sun.

pieces.title: Gingham at Golden Hour
pieces.description: A redhead in a red gingham dress leans on a split-rail fence as the sunset sets the wheat field behind her on fire.

pieces.title: Red Hair Over the Wheat
pieces.description: A red-haired woman in a white dress leans on a fence rail, her hair catching the wind and the last gold of the evening.

pieces.title: Dusk on the Porch Rail
pieces.description: A curly-haired woman in a white eyelet dress sits on a porch rail among the flowers, eyes closed in the soft dusk light.

pieces.title: Peach Blossom at the Barn
pieces.description: A woman with long braids in a peach floral sundress leans on a barn stall in the sunbeams while her horse looks on.
